title: Resident Accounts Schedule: Entrance Fee Amortization Rates and Refundable Floors
content:
Resident Accounts schedule of the three percentages that drive the refundable balance of an **Entrance Fee Agreement**: the administrative percentage that becomes non-refundable on the occupancy date, the monthly amortization percentage, and the refundable floor that never amortizes.

| Refund plan | Administrative percentage at occupancy | Monthly amortization percentage | Refundable floor |
|---|---|---|---|
| LifeChoice Declining Balance Plan | 4 | 2.0 | 0 |
| LifeChoice 50% Refundable Plan | 4 | 2.0 | 50 |
| LifeChoice 75% Refundable Plan | 4 | 1.5 | 75 |
| LifeChoice 90% Refundable Plan | 4 | 1.0 | 90 |
| LifeCare Declining Balance Plan | 4 | 2.0 | 0 |
| LifeCare 90% Refundable Plan | 4 | 1.0 | 90 |

All three columns are percentages of the entrance fee of the agreement.

## Notes

- The administrative percentage is the same 4 percent under every plan.
- A floor of 0 means the whole entrance fee can amortize; a floor of 90 means 90 percent of the entrance fee stays refundable however long the residency lasts.
- The two declining balance plans share the 2.0 percent monthly rate; the two 90% refundable plans share the 1.0 percent rate.
